info.title: Egi Media API
info.description: REST API for Egi Media — a Bloomberg-style media platform. Covers authentication, content management, subscriptions, newsletters, notifications, and more.

Newsletter.description: Indonesian (id) is stored in the base fields (name, description). English (en) and Uzbek (uz) live in the *_en and *_uz fields and are null until translated.

NewsletterTranslation.description: Optional per-locale translation. Provide 'name' to make the translation meaningful; 'description' is optional.

post.description: Registers a new user with email and password. Default role is `visitor`. Role is upgraded to `member` after subscribing. Sends an email verification link.
Invalidates the current refresh token. Client must clear local tokens.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Email verification token from email link

post.description: Resends a new email verification link to the registered email address if it has not been verified yet.

400.description: Email is already verified or registered using social login

200.description: Reset link sent to email if account exists

get.description: Redirects the browser to Google consent screen.
Handles Google OAuth callback. Returns JWT tokens on success.

post.description: Creates a new user account with role `author`. Only accessible by superadmin. The author's email is automatically verified.

delete.description: Sets deleted_at on the user record.

get.description: Public endpoint with optional filters for category, topic, tag, author, and series.
Public endpoint. Records an article view for authenticated users.

patch.description: Transitions: draft -> review -> published, published -> archived. Superadmin can change any; authors can only change own articles.

delete.description: Sets is_active = false. Does not hard delete.

post.description: Creates a new user subscription entry. Validates payment reference against payment gateway.

patch.description: Sets subscription status to 'cancelled'. The subscription remains active until expired_at.

post.summary: Add article to newsletter (superadmin and author)

delete.summary: Remove article from newsletter (superadmin and author)

post.summary: Add a YouTube video (superadmin and author)
